summary: Annexon, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Loan and Security Agreement with Oxford Finance LLC and certain lenders. The agreement provides up to $200 million in term loans, with an initial $50 million tranche funded on July 30, 2026, plus additional tranches subject to milestones and mutual agreement. Loans bear floating interest at the greater of 1-Month CME Term SOFR plus 4.6% or 7.60%, with maturity in 2031 or 2032. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation, so no further analysis is warranted.
